'''Liar''' is a [[social skill]] used by dwarves while making friends. Dwarves that are particularly good at this tend to make friends easily and will often rise to [[mayor|mayoral]] positions. 

To train this skill, let dwarves idle and chatter amongst themselves. The only dwarves that [[Personality trait#TRUTH|do not value the truth]] gain [[experience]] skill in lying. These dwarves also never gain experience in the [[consoler]] skill, and are not amazingly good at calming unhappy dwarves down during [[meeting]]s.
